steps.text: Silence. The ship is gone. Only one suit light is still blinking.
Emily... can you hear me? Anyone?
Only static. Breathing gets slow and heavy.
Then, out of the dark, something golden drifts closer.
A dish antenna. A long arm. A golden disc... No. It can't be.
Voyager 1. Emily told us about you, back in the bunker.
Launched in 1977. Past Jupiter, past Saturn. In 2012 you left the Sun's bubble, into interstellar space.
And you carry the Golden Record. Greetings in 55 languages, music, rain, laughter, pictures of Earth.
Instructions on the cover, so anyone who finds you can play it.
But Voyager 1 is more than 24 billion kilometers away. It could never be here.
I know. My oxygen is almost gone. I'm seeing things.
ZENTRA to base. Mission complete. The parts are coming home, Emily. Build something new with them.
The real Voyager 1 is still out there, still talking to Earth. Waiting for the day someone might discover it.
